install_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nginx
uninstall_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get remove -y nginx || true
apt-get autoremove -y || true
upgrade_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --only-upgrade nginx
